player_prompt.intro:
Tirid ṭṭṛiq n ukan Tower of Hanoi s {num_disks} ṭṣḍiḥin.
Yessefk ad tesleḍ ṭṣḍiḥin seg ukan A ɣer ukan C.
Akcem ṭṣḍiḥ, arki s ukan aɣbalu d ukan aneggaru (s umedya, '[A C]').
Ɣur ad tesleḍ ṭṣḍiḥ aɣella n ukan, d ṭṣḍiḥ meqqer ur yessefk ad yettwasekkel ɣef ṭṣḍiḥ alemmas.
Di kraygat tawla, azen ṭṣḍiḥ waḥed.
